### Bible Pathway - Feb. 23, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-feb-23-2010-11626546.html
Passage: Numbers 25:1-3
Points:
- While encamped peacefully at Shittim, Israelite men let down their guard and were seduced into sexual immorality and idolatry.
- Violating their covenant of loyalty to the Lord provoked divine judgment in the form of a deadly plague.
- True faith requires turning entirely away from worldly idols to serve only the living God.
- Believers must resist cultural pressure to compromise and instead honor God by keeping their bodies holy.

### Read the Bible: Numbers 25, Psalm 68, Isaiah 15, 1 Peter 3
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/numbers-25-psalm-68-isaiah-15-1-peter-3/
Passage: Numbers 25:1-5
Points:
- When spiritual curses against Israel failed, their enemies used seduction to lure them into sexual sin and Baal worship.
- Moab intentionally enticed the Israelites into covenant-breaking actions to draw God's own wrath down upon them.
- Israel's great evil was discarding their calling to be set apart, choosing instead to blend in with pagan neighbors.
- This failure serves as a solemn warning for the church against cultural compromises that bring divine judgment.
